question: Do native boundary distributions contain action-conditioned localization evidence beyond expected boxes and Gaussian mean/variance?
prior_art_boundary: GFL and GFLV2 already use box distributions and their statistics for localization quality estimation. This screen is not an invention of DFL uncertainty or quality prediction. A possible later question is action-relative cross-view likelihood, which still needs closer prior review.
sample: Unchanged first64 head-held-out train images from candidate12/candidate18. Previously trained and repeatedly viewed data; not independent detector generalization.
budget: 320 frozen960 forwards plus extractor warmup, no training, no official evaluator, no sweep. Preserve five original crops and FP16 prediction path.
replay: Every kept view exactly equals original candidate12 raw capture; decoding raw DFL through installed native decoder must exactly equal captured decoded boxes. Save installed head/block/ops hashes and do not change them.
association: For each frozen uniform baseline row, in each view choose the same-argmax-class decoded native anchor at confidence>=0.05 and IoU>=0.5 maximizing IoU times native score. This association depends on predictions only, and is FIXED across all six coordinate actions.
representation: Read the native FP16 softmax probabilities of the four16-bin DFL sides. Map each proposed action edge into that fixed anchor's view/stride coordinates with exact letterbox scale/padding and full-image crop offset. Use linear interpolation between adjacent bin masses, floor1e-9 outside [0,15] or at zero. This is an uncalibrated mass score, not a true boundary probability.

scores.distribution: Mean over four sides and available views of log interpolated native bin mass
scores.mean_distance: Negative mean absolute side distance to the DFL expected distance in bin units, same anchors/views
scores.gaussian: Mean Gaussian log density at side distance from the native mean and variance, variance floored1e-6, same anchors/views

labels: Only after feature construction, use candidate18 nominal same-owned-GT IoUs. Valid nonuniform actions on owned rows, calibrated score>=0.25, and at least two available views. Positive IoU gain>0.01 over uniform, negative gain<-0.01; omit near ties. Weight each retained action by inverse count of retained actions on its anchor.
primary: tiny weighted AUROC for beneficial versus harmful actions, scored as each action minus its uniform reference. Report small_all/all too. AUROC is a discrimination proxy, not actual localization gain, AP or AR.
pass_action: Only permits separately registering a small matched scene-split learning pilot with ordinary geometry and GFLV2-style statistics controls. No full detector training.
fail_action: Stop this fixed interpolated-DFL likelihood evidence recipe. Do not change density floor, association, interpolation, aggregation, label margin or primary subgroup on these images.
limits: DFL targets encode discretized supervised offsets, not calibrated aleatoric uncertainty. Conditional owned-row discrimination excludes unowned misses. View predictions share weights and image content. Uniform diagnostic ignore filtering is inherited from cached action rows.
